random_tasks: Rename bounty: find the single vaguest identifier in the codebase and ticket it
Comment cull: hunt narrating or stale comments ('// increment counter', dead TODOs, obvious narration)
Units hunt: find any variable storing a duration, size, or count without units in its name (e.g. 'duration' instead of 'durationMs')
Terminology check: pick one concept (e.g. 'frame', 'beat', 'clip', 'layer') and verify it's named consistently across all files
JSDoc audit: pick one module and check every public method has accurate @param and @returns
Magic number hunt: find literal numbers in akvj/src/ or mainframe/src/ that deserve a named constant
File ↔ class check: verify every PascalCase file exports a class or element with a matching name
Celebrate the best-named thing you find this sweep — and still file at least one nit while you're there
